mapper.select: SELECT A.id as articleId, A.slug as slug, A.title as title, U.username as authorUsername, COUNT(DISTINCT AV.id) as viewCount, COUNT(DISTINCT AF.article_id || '-' || AF.user_id) as favoritesCount, COUNT(DISTINCT C.id) as commentsCount, A.created_at as createdAt, A.word_count as wordCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN V.viewed_at >= datetime('now', '-1 day') THEN 3 WHEN V.viewed_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ), 0) FROM article_views V WHERE V.article_id = A.id) as trendingScore FROM articles A LEFT JOIN article_views AV ON A.id = AV.article_id LEFT JOIN article_favorites AF ON A.id = AF.article_id LEFT JOIN comments C ON A.id = C.article_id LEFT JOIN users U ON A.user_id = U.id GROUP BY A.id, A.slug, A.title, U.username, A.created_at, A.word_count ORDER BY viewCount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_views WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
